item.title: Candidate forum slated Feb. 26 at Crescent
item.description: The Greater Eureka Springs Chamber of Commerce will host a Local Area Primary Candidate Forum at 6 p.m. Thursday, Feb. 26, in the Crystal Ballroom at the 1886 Crescent Hotel. The post Candidate forum slated Feb. 26 at Crescent appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Please vote
item.description: E arly voting is underway in the 2026 preferential primary, non-partisan judicial and school election in Carroll County. If you’re a registered voter, I urge you to exercise your right to vote. It makes no difference to me whether you’re a conservative or a liberal, a Republican or a Democrat. If you’re a citizen of our great nation and you’ve reached voting age, I believe it’s not just your right but your inherent duty to participate in the democratic process. There are a lot of ways to do that

item.title: Carol Carraro Greer
item.description: Carol Carraro Greer, 90, of Eureka Springs, Arkansas, passed away peacefully on January 31st, surrounded by her family in Bentonville, Arkansas. The post Carol Carraro Greer appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Gloria Lucille (Crow) Kelley
item.description: Our loving mother, Gloria Lucille (Crow) Kelley, was born in Mulvane, Kansas on August 15, 1936 to Ben and Ida Crow. She departed this life on Thursday, January 29, 2026 at her home in Eureka Springs, Arkansas with family by her side at the age of 89. The post Gloria Lucille (Crow) Kelley appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Body recovered after Holiday Island fire
item.description: A man’s body was recovered after a house fire on Friday, Feb. 13, in Holiday Island, according to the Carroll County Sheriff’s Office. The post Body recovered after Holiday Island fire appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Early voting underway in Carroll County
item.description: Early voting in the March 3 preferential primary and non-partisan judicial election began Tuesday, Feb. 17, and will continue through Monday, March 2. The post Early voting underway in Carroll County appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Mayor continues recovery from illness
item.description: Eureka Springs Mayor Butch Berry remains in recovery mode after suffering an undisclosed illness that originally left him in intensive care for a number of days. The post Mayor continues recovery from illness appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.
